name: Convex Contouring with Decision Trees
definition: A table-driven contouring method that produces topologically consistent surfaces with a local convexity property, where the polygonal contour inside each cell encloses a convex negative space.
summary: Convex Contouring with Decision Trees is a table-driven isosurface extraction technique that uses pre-computed decision trees to dynamically select triangulations, ensuring topologically consistent surfaces with local convexity for fast collision detection.
